name: ribbon-road-regional
about: A sound text-only ad: an empty road through wheat at sunrise, the words at the top. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `ribbon` look (centred Anton headline, pill button, a hairline over the legal line): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-road-regional`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: the headline is about the road and the picture is the road

subject_legible.reason: A straight road cutting through golden farm fields at sunset is instantly recognizable at a glance — no clutter, no ambiguity.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline 'Regional runs through farm country' is perfectly echoed by a road stretching through open farmland, making headline and image one unified message.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The bold white headline dominates the dark blue top panel, the pill-shaped button sits cleanly beneath it, and the scenic photo doesn't compete with either element.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep navy (#1F3A5F) fills the top panel and the button outline, white is used for the headline and button text, and no off-brand colours appear, though no logo is present to reinforce the carrier identity further.
